SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') m, s.store_id=999 t, p.category='ZZ Test' z, f.channel_code, s.store_id>=900 web, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dl, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) drl, sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gross, sum(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)) calc, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') m, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gross,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mism,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate) ELSE 0 END) mismsum,
 min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT business_date sale_date, store_id, net_sales_before_returns nb, receipts FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id<900)
SELECT strftime(coalesce(w.sale_date,r.sale_date),'%Y-%m') m, count(*) cells, sum(w.net) wnet, sum(r.nb) rnb,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(w.net,0)-coalesce(r.nb,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diffcells,
 sum(CASE WHEN w.net IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) only_rpt, sum(CASE WHEN r.nb IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) only_fact,
 sum(CASE WHEN w.rc<>r.receipts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rcdiff
FROM w FULL JOIN r ON w.sale_date=r.sale_date AND w.store_id=r.store_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nostore, sum(CASE WHEN p.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) noprod,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) storeout,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonposq,
 count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <> sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) datediff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-30' AND DATE '2024-10-02'

SELECT CAST(strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y') AS INTEGER) AS calendar_year, CAST(strftime(f.sale_date,'%m') AS INTEGER) AS calendar_month, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
